title: Lesson Calendar - Publish Action - Draft Lesson - Click Publish Lesson - Status Changes To Published
description: AC 01.5 - State Transition - User publishes a draft lesson directly from calendar menu without opening lesson detail page.
preconditions: - Logged in as HQ or CM Staff on Salesforce calendar.\n- A lesson with status Draft exists on calendar day view.\n- Lesson detail page is not opened in current browser tab.
steps_actions:
1. Open Lesson Calendar and select a Draft lesson card.
2. Open the right-side lesson menu and click Publish Lesson.
3. Refresh calendar view and reopen the same lesson card.
4. Confirm current tab remains Lesson Calendar screen.
steps_result:
1. Lesson detail side menu opens in calendar context.
2. Publish action is accepted from calendar menu.
3. Lesson status shows Published and Publish Lesson action is no longer displayed.
4. User is still on calendar and did not navigate to lesson detail page.
steps_data:
1. lesson_status = Draft
2. trigger = calendar_menu
3. expected_status = Published
4. navigation = stay_on_calendar
suite: Publish Lesson Menu in Lesson Calendar

title: Lesson Calendar - Publish Action - Non SF Surfaces - Publish Lesson Entry Point - Not Exposed
description: AC 01.6 - Permission Matrix - Publish Lesson menu entry point is SF-only and does not appear on BO or mobile surfaces.
preconditions: - Draft lesson exists for the same tenant data set.\n- User has access to SF and BO environments.
steps_actions: 1. Open Salesforce Lesson Calendar and select the Draft lesson menu.\n2. Open Back Office lesson management for the same draft lesson.\n3. Open mobile lesson surfaces for the same draft lesson if available.
steps_result: 1. Publish Lesson action is visible in SF calendar menu.\n2. Calendar-menu Publish Lesson entry point is not available in BO.\n3. Calendar-menu Publish Lesson entry point is not available in mobile surfaces.
steps_data: 1. surface = SF\n2. surface = BO\n3. surface = Mobile
suite: Publish Lesson Menu in Lesson Calendar

title: Lesson Calendar - Publish Action - Stale Draft Menu - Click Publish Lesson - Graceful Rejection
description: AC 01.5 - Negative - If another user publishes the lesson first, stale menu click does not create invalid transition and calendar reflects final Published state.
preconditions: - Session A and Session B are both opened as HQ or CM Staff.\n- Same lesson is Draft in both sessions before action.
steps_actions: 1. In Session B publish the draft lesson and confirm status becomes Published.\n2. In Session A without refreshing click Publish Lesson from stale menu state.\n3. Refresh Session A calendar and reopen the lesson.
steps_result: 1. Session B shows lesson status Published.\n2. System rejects duplicate publish attempt without creating invalid state.\n3. Lesson remains Published and Publish Lesson action is not displayed.
steps_data: 1. actor_b_action = publish\n2. actor_a_state = stale_draft\n3. expected_status = Published
